title: ArGEnT: Arbitrary Geometry-encoded Transformer for Operator Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.11626v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning solution operators on arbitrary geometries remains a central challenge in scientific machine learning, especially for many-query simulation, physics-informed learning, and evolving geometries requiring accurate, geometry-aware predictions at arbitrary spatial locations. Existing operator-learning methods often rely on structured discretizations, explicit geometry parameterizations, or point-cloud formulations that couple geometric representation with solution-query sampling, limiting flexibility on irregular and non-parameterized domains. We propose the Arbitrary Geometry-encoded Transformer (ArGEnT), a geometry-conditioned attention framework that decouples geometry encoding from query-point evaluation. We develop three variants: self-attention, cross-attention, and hybrid-attention. ArGEnT can be used independently or integrated with neural operators to incorporate non-geometric physical inputs. translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.11626v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：在任意几何上学习解算子仍然是科学机器学习中的一个核心挑战，特别是在多查询模拟、物理信息学习和演化几何中，需要在任意空间位置进行准确且几何感知的预测。现有的算子学习方法通常依赖于结构化离散化、显式几何参数化或点云公式，这些方法将几何表示与解查询采样耦合在一起，限制了在不规则和非参数化域上的灵活性。我们提出了任意几何编码Transformer（ArGEnT），一种几何条件注意力框架，将几何编码与查询点评估解耦。我们开发了三种变体：自注意力、交叉注意力和混合注意力。ArGEnT可以独立使用，或与神经算子集成以纳入非几何物理输入。在交叉注意力中...
tldr: ArGEnT提出了一种几何条件注意力框架，通过解耦几何编码与查询点评估，在任意和不规则几何上实现了灵活且准确的算子学习，支持独立使用或与神经算子集成。
en_tdlr: ArGEnT proposes a geometry-conditioned attention framework that decouples geometry encoding from query-point evaluation, enabling flexible and accurate operator learning on arbitrary and irregular geometries, with support for standalone use or integration with neural operators.
